note_en: English "must" and "should" map onto 必须 and 应该, and this text uses both at the crucial moment: 方舟必须做出选择 "Fangzhou had to make a choice" (no way around it), but 根据规则，它应该优先保证救护车通行 "according to the rule, it should give the ambulance priority" (what's expected, not unavoidable). Note that 必须 has no past form: Chinese uses the same word for "must" and "had to" and lets the context supply the time.
